core_obligations: Transfer the lifting property: given a horn-lifting problem over Y', pull it back along Y' to Y and lift there, then project the lift to X times_Y Y'; the functoriality of the fibre product is what makes the two constructions compatible (source lines 5809-5811).

proof_roadmap.step: Apply the functoriality of the fibre product to transfer the lifting property.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-trivial-kan-base-change at source lines 5802-5807: if f : X to Y is a trivial Kan fibration and Y' to Y is any morphism of simplicial sets, then the base change X times_Y Y' to Y' is again a trivial Kan fibration. The author's proof at source lines 5809-5812 is a single sentence declaring that this follows immediately from the functorial properties of the fibre product and the definitions. The card therefore counts a statement whose proof is a pointer; the fibre-product lemma it names is retained as context, so the reduction is complete inside the package, and the pairing note records that the author supplied no further detail.
